versions.content: Shall support different Approaches to derive from Blueprints 24 of 57  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 536: AUTOSAR_RS_StandardizationTemplate Requirements on Standardization Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: Shall support different approaches to derive from blueprints. Such different approaches are 0. The user makes a kind of copy of the blueprint and is allowed to add his own things (e.g. adding own field to a standardized enum-type). 0. The user can only configure or otherwise influence the content of the copied blueprint in a completely standardized way, (e.g. configuring the fields of an enum-type according to the needs of the software) but he cannot add own things. Rationale: This allows to use Standardization Models to evaluate conformity of an implementation. Conformity depends on the approach to derive objects Use Case: [UC_STDT_00007],[UC_STDT_00011],[UC_STDT_00012] Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
